featured_reviews.review_text:
Rajasthan Trip Review – Sanket Travels, Ghatkopar

Our Rajasthan trip organized by Sanket Travels, Ghatkopar, under the excellent coordination of Jackie, was a truly smooth and memorable experience.

There was absolutely no hassle during hotel check-in or check-out, which made the journey very comfortable. Our clear preference was for hotels with hygienic rooms and bathrooms, along with healthy vegetarian food and local specialties, and Jackie ensured all our expectations were met perfectly.

The car provided was excellent, and we were fortunate to have Mr. Dinesh as our driver—professional, friendly, and knowledgeable. In just a few days, he felt more like a good friend than a driver, adding great value to our travel experience.

Even last-moment flight bookings with preferred seats were managed efficiently, showcasing the team’s reliability and commitment.

We have been using Sanket Travels’ services since 2016, and every trip has been well-planned and worry-free. Highly recommended for anyone looking for personalized, dependable travel planning.
